segments.name: Branded Services
segments.description: Sales, merchandising, and omni-commerce marketing support to branded CPG manufacturers.
segments.evidence: Branded Services provides sales, merchandising, and omni‑commerce marketing support to branded CPG manufacturers.

segments.name: Experiential Services
segments.description: In-store and digital sampling programs, demonstrations, and experiential events for manufacturers and retailers.
segments.evidence: Experiential Services provides in‑store and digital sampling programs, demonstrations, and experiential events for manufacturers and retailers.

segments.name: Retailer Services
segments.description: Solutions supporting retailers in merchandising execution, private brands, and retail-media marketing initiatives.
segments.evidence: Retailer Services provides solutions that support retailers in the development of in‑store merchandising execution, private brands and retail‑media and marketing initiatives.

revenueModel.text: CPG manufacturers and retailers pay through commissions, fee-for-service arrangements, and cost-plus structures depending on engagement nature.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue model consists of commissions, fee for service arrangements, and cost-plus structures depending on the nature of the engagement.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2024, the company realigned its organization and began reporting results under three segments: Branded Services, Experiential Services, and Retailer Services, with prior-period segment information recast to conform to the new structure.
changes.evidence: Beginning in fiscal year 2024, we reported our results under three segments, Branded Services, Experiential Services and Retailer Services, reflecting the organizational realignment implemented on January 1, 2024.

changes.text: During 2024 and 2025, the company executed portfolio simplification strategy including disposition of certain non-core businesses that met discontinued operations criteria.
changes.evidence: We continued to execute the portfolio simplification strategy initiated in 2024, including the disposition of certain non‑core businesses that met the discontinued operations criteria and the associated reclassification of prior‑period results.
